summary: Vulnerability in AWS SDK Go v2 eventstream decoder where malformed EventStream headers can trigger a panic, causing denial-of-service and potentially crashing the application. Fixed in the main branch for v1.31.0 release.
userImpact: Applications using Temporal with the vulnerable AWS SDK Go v2 version can crash when receiving malformed EventStream headers, resulting in denial-of-service.
rootCause: AWS SDK Go v2 eventstream decoder does not properly validate EventStream headers, causing panic on malformed input
proposedFix: Upgrade to patched version of AWS SDK Go v2 (fixed in main branch, included in v1.31.0)
resolutionDetails: Fixed in the main branch and will be included in the v1.31.0 release
keyQuote: denial-of-service issue where malformed EventStream headers can trigger a panic in the decoder, potentially crashing the application
